name: Eichiko-Home
description: minimal home terminal display to minimize information overload with a focused personal dashboard. for specific info such as TFL London Transport & Formula 1 related

paragraphs: That's my cat's name in case you were wondering. It's a personal real-time dashboard designed to be fully responsive across all devices, styled as an LED dot-matrix departure board. Displays live London transport data, local weather, and upcoming calendar events all in one place.
Built to minimize information overload with a focused, personal dashboard that streamlines daily routines.
features: Shows current conditions for a user-selected location: temperature, probability of rain, and a rotating casual phrase that regularly updates.
Title: Tap to edit the dashboard title (e.g., "EICHIKO'S HOME")
Location: Tap to search and change the weather location using OpenWeatherMap Geocoding API
Changes persist to localStorage and survive page refresh

Collapsible panel (collapsed by default) showing live service status for all TFL lines and National Rail routes relevant to London. TFL lines are shown on the left; London National Rail operators on the right. Each line…
